Booker Prize Shortlist Announced, Potential for Multiple Winners

The shortlist for the Booker Prize has been announced. Marlon James and Douglas Stuart are among the nominees, with a chance to become the fifth authors to win the award twice. The shortlist also includes a nominee who could become the oldest ever winner of the prize.
